contributing_factors.source_quote: At 16:52 UTC, an automated maintenance task that did not honor the pause put it back in charge, and the outage happened again.
contributing_factors.text: An automated maintenance task did not honor the pause and put the new machine back in charge, which caused the second outage.

contributing_factors.text: The automation ignored the pause because of a regression from an update of the puppet infrastructure.

fixes.source_quote: we are clearing retired database servers from the service's records before any new machine is added

fixes.text: Prevent new machines from being elected leader until their records have been checked.

fixes.text: Give responders a faster way to take a misbehaving machine out of service.

root_cause.source_quote: one of the new machines started with an outdated copy of its records, which still listed database servers we had already retired. When this node came online, it incorrectly modified routing configuration with the outdated records, routing write requests to non-existent database servers.
root_cause.text: A new machine of the internal service that tracks which database servers receive new and updated data started, during routine machine replacement, with an outdated copy of its records that still listed retired database servers; when it came online it modified routing configuration to send write requests to database servers that no longer existed.

timeline.event: First outage began: write operations failed across Git operations, pull requests, issues, Actions, the API, webhooks, and other services.
